method: tools/probes/CommandProbe.java instantiates the 48 command classes ServerCommandManager's constructor registers (its class list and the dedicated/LAN branches are read from javap bytecode, since the constructor needs a MinecraftServer) and reads getCommandName, getCommandAliases, getRequiredPermissionLevel and getCommandUsage; drives CommandBase's static parsers with a proxy ICommandSender; dumps Item/Block registries, EntityList, Potion, Enchantment, GameRules and GameType. Permission rule, help paging and chat constants are asserted against javap bytecode.

permissionRule.singleplayer: EntityPlayerMP.canCommandSenderUseCommand(level, name): 'seed' is always allowed when the server is not dedicated; 'tell', 'help' and 'me' are always allowed; everything else requires ServerConfigurationManager.func_152596_g (op): the world owner when WorldInfo.areCommandsAllowed (Allow Cheats), then IntegratedServer.getOpPermissionLevel() = 4 >= the command's level.
permissionRule.openToLan: GuiShareToLan 'Allow Cheats' sets ServerConfigurationManager.commandsAllowedForAll (field s) for guests; the owner still needs the world's commandsAllowed flag.

failureColour: EnumChatFormatting.RED (a.m) for commands.generic.permission, .usage, .exception and every CommandException

chat.inputBackground: 0x80000000 (Integer.MIN_VALUE) from (2, height - 14) to (width - 2, height - 2); text 0xE0E0E0 at (4, height - 12)
